job: The first thing a user sees. The tour: the promise, the how, the seven rooms. The one surface allowed to explain, under a ration: every sentence on the page is in this file; nothing else may be written.
copy_contract: Every visible text is a string from this file (or a number derived from one). Sentences only from `sentences`. Labels only from `labels` and the room/step names. No taglines, no marketing adjectives, no invented claims.

registers_to_combine: warm paper — the morning edition (Today: rgb 248,247,245 ground, serif voice)
dark institution (all other rooms: #1B1917 ground, hairline frames, corner marks)
monospace workstation (Simulation, Portfolio, Pipeline: JetBrains Mono, sage #9CB08C good / clay #C17A52 miss)
the auction-lot serif (Dossier: large quiet serif display, catalogue numbering)
identity.rule: One page, one skeleton: the same nav strip, hairlines, single sage accent family across the boundary between paper and dark. The page may cross from paper to dark once (as the product does between Today and the working rooms).

sentences.promise: An autonomous engine for agricultural innovation — reading continuously, judged adversarially, ruled by one human.
sentences.promise_2: It reads the literature, breeds candidate innovations, argues about them in a council, simulates the winners, and carries them into the field.
sentences.owner: The owner does not operate the machine. The owner reviews winners, believes or challenges the receipts, and decides.
sentences.receipts: Every claim carries its source. Every verdict is recorded with its reason. Nothing is deleted.
sentences.reality: Approved claims stay frozen beside what the field measured, for the rest of the bet's life.
sentences.honesty: Where the machine cannot answer, it says so: cannot simulate is a verdict, not an error.
sentences.domain: Built for commercial poultry first. The engine is general.
